title: On‑Prem VPC Weekly Scratchpad — Project Helios
content:
Purpose:
Quick prep + live scratchpad for the weekly Project Helios private deployment sync. Focus areas: VPC connectivity, on‑prem hardware readiness, security/compliance checklist, and what we need the customer to unblock before next deploy window.

High‑level summary (current):
- Customer: Helios Financial (pilot environment). Goal: VPC peering + on‑prem inference cluster (8x A100 equiv) behind customer firewall for regulated model serving.
- Current phase: pre‑network validation and initial install window scheduling.
- Primary risks: network CIDR conflict, customer change freeze for next two weeks, HC/rack availability slip to week of 3/22.

Agenda items to cover (10–15 min each):
1) Network & routing (owner: Tom) — status of CIDR allocations, peering test plan, expected NAT/gateway config.
2) Hardware & DC coordination (owner: Marina) — rack/power confirmation, racking window options, on‑site access (badges/contacts).
3) Security & certs (owner: Priya) — KMS integration plan, HSM/key escrow, audit log retention and SIEM forwarding.
4) Install timeline & rollback plan (owner: Ethan) — install steps for first node, canary traffic plan, fallback to hosted model if failure.
5) Customer asks / escalation items — list and assign.

Notes / updates since last week:
- Customer network team supplied a high‑level topology PDF (see Confluence link). Initial review shows Helios internal CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 — potential overlap with our shared test CIDR. Action: Tom to propose alternative peering via transit GW (HELIO-412).
- DC contact (Marcus at EquiData) responded: 3xU contiguous available but shipment delayed; rack window tentatively 3/22–3/24. Marina to confirm before EOD Friday.
- Customer legal requested SC‑1 clause re: data residency; product legal looped in. Outcome pending — may impact logging retention settings.
- KMS/Key import window: customer proposes customer‑managed KMS in GCP; Priya to draft integration steps and list required IAM roles.

Blockers (priority order):
1) CIDR overlap identified — blocks peering validation and prevents VPN tests. (Blocker owner: Tom)
2) DC rack availability uncertain — delays entire install timeline if not confirmed. (Owner: Marina)
3) Customer change freeze on their infra starting 3/18 — narrows our deploy windows; need buy‑in to allow exception for security patching only. (CS owner: Liam?)
4) Legal signoff on SC‑1 change — affects logging/audit approach. (Owner: Priya)

Open questions / items to raise with customer during sync:
- Can Helios carve a /20 alternative CIDR for our peering to avoid overlap? If not, do they allow NATed edge? (Target: decision in this meeting)
- Will on‑site team be available 3/22? If no, propose 3/29 as backup.
- Confirm whether they will provide a customer‑managed GCP KMS key with import permissions or require an HSM workflow.
- Which SIEM endpoint do we forward logs to? Need IP + port + cert details.

Action items & owners (tracking):
- Tom Reynolds: Draft peering proposal with transit GW option; add fallback VPN NAT plan. Due: 2026-03-15. Jira: HELIO-412.
- Marina Gomez: Confirm rack/power window with EquiData and get on‑site contact name + badge request process. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Priya Narang: Produce KMS/HSM integration checklist + required IAM policy snippets; coordinate with legal on SC‑1 language. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Ethan Liu: Prepare canary deployment runbook (step‑by‑step for first node), include rollback script and smoke tests. Due: 2026-03-18.
- Aisha Patel (me): Follow up with CS (Liam) to request exception for change freeze for security updates during install window; create escalation note for Sales if needed. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Customer action (Helios NetOps): Provide alternate CIDR or approve NAT workaround; share SIEM endpoint and KMS approach. Requested by: 2026-03-13.

Quick checklists to reference in meeting (short bullets we can tick):
- Peering: CIDR allocated / route map / BGP ASN exchanged.
- VPN: pre-shared key agreed / MTU tested / iperf window scheduled.
- DC: rack elevation plan / PDU mapping / cable labeling scheme.
- Security: KMS key accessible / audit streams defined / SOC contact.
- Rollout: canary node up / perf baseline / fallback to hosted configured.

Escalation plan (if top blockers persist):
- If CIDR cannot be resolved in 48h: request Sales and Solutions Eng to run customer workshop to re‑architect network isolation (high effort but avoids blocking pilot).
- If rack confirmed > 3/25: push install to next fiscal sprint and keep customer on hosted with capacity reserves.

Meeting script / opening lines:
- 0–2m: quick roundtable updates from each owner (Tom / Marina / Priya / Ethan).
- 2–8m: hit the CIDR question first (critical path). Get explicit decision or next action.
- 8–18m: hardware confirmation and install window — confirm on‑site contact and badge process.
- 18–25m: security & KMS confirmation + legal blocker status.
- Last 2–3m: summarize action owners and due dates; confirm next sync time (propose weekly same slot).

Notes to self after meeting (template):
- Capture explicit customer commit string for CIDR or NAT option in Slack thread and Jira.
- Create short email template to SOC and DC site ops with requested access and contact forms.
- If legal requires SC‑1 change, schedule 30m with product legal + CS to scope logging changes.

Misc / scratch thoughts (random):
- Consider pre-uploading a trimmed container image to customer S3 bucket (if they provide credentials) to reduce on‑site transfer time. Ask customer about Egress restrictions.
- If EquiData charges for remote hands, ask for cost cap from Sales before committing to extra days.

End of scratchpad.

Recent edits: added escalation plan and tightened due dates (3/13 for SIEM + CIDR ask).

-- Aisha
